what: One load for what blaze-mem has committed (speed-sol-core's request 00863, mem half done). `blaze_mem::tag::committed_now()` now exists in crates/blaze-mem/src/tag.rs (`COMMITTED.now.load(Relaxed)`, the same value `snapshot().committed` reads). Exact edit in crates/blaze-graph/src/arena.rs `own()` (line 220): `held().saturating_add(blaze_mem::tag::snapshot().committed)` becomes `held().saturating_add(blaze_mem::tag::committed_now())`, and the doc link on line 218 `[blaze_mem::tag::Snapshot::committed]` becomes `[blaze_mem::tag::committed_now]`. Why: snapshot() folds the thread's pending counts and does 100 relaxed loads over 20 lines every worker writes, about 2 us on the scheduler's owner thread per plane message batch, to use one field; one load is about 5 ns. Same value, so the test at line 570 stays as is.
